messages.subject: prcomp function eval (PCA)
parts:
Hi guys,
I'm using the Renjin for PCA (Principal component analysis). After eval the prcomp function it was found that some dll dependency is loaded behind the scene
Log:
Sep 14, 2018 2:56:28 PM com.github.fommil.netlib.LAPACK <clinit>
WARNING: Failed to load implementation from: com.github.fommil.netlib.NativeSystemLAPACK
Sep 14, 2018 2:56:28 PM com.github.fommil.jni.JniLoader liberalLoad
INFO: successfully loaded C:\Users\Dev\AppData\Local\Temp\jniloader7632072737104995464netlib-native_ref-win-x86_64.dll

My question is how to prevent the dependency loading and make the Renjin work out of the box with no such things?

Regards,
Dima

messages.author: f06db63329fab1f9
messages.subject: Re: prcomp function eval (PCA)
parts:
Hi Dima,
Renjin, through the netlib-java library, will try to load a native version of blas/lapack libraries if they are available. Renjin actuallly ships with such libraries for osx-x86_64, linux-x86_64, linux-i686, win-x86_64, win-i686, and linux-armhf, but will use more efficient system libraries if available like GotoBlas or Intel MKL.

If if for whatever reason Renjin isn't able to load a native version of the library, it will fall back to a pure java version, so it remains platform independent.


If you want to turn off native libraries all together, you can provide the following JVM flags:

-Dcom.github.fommil.netlib.BLAS=com.github.fommil.netlib.F2jBLAS
-Dcom.github.fommil.netlib.LAPACK=com.github.fommil.netlib.F2jLAPACK
-Dcom.github.fommil.netlib.ARPACK=com.github.fommil.netlib.F2jARPACK

You can find more details on the netlib-java page:
https://github.com/fommil/netlib-java

Best,
Alex
